entities.summary: Saint Domnius was a Bishop of Salona around the year 300, and is venerated as the patron of the nearby city of Split in modern Croatia. He played a significant role in the early Christianization of Dalmatia, an area now part of Croatia. Saint Domnius' legacy extends to the current day, with his feast day celebrated on January 11th and his image appearing on various Croatian coins and monuments. The complex architecture surrounding his tomb, which includes the Cathedral of Saint Domnius in Split, is a testament to his enduring influence on Dalmatian culture.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Saint Domnius played a significant role in the early Christianization of Dalmatia, an area now part of Croatia. His legacy continues to be felt today through various artistic and architectural representations.
